verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration-services provider with case-status dashboards and People Ops integrations. A service platform like this could plausibly publish an official MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server or any agent connectivity: the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes all return 404. The 'apply via an agent' reference in docs-14 means an immigration petitioning agent, not an AI agent.
